warningMessage: Dune: Awakening uses the official dedicated-server deployment system. Hyper-V and hardware virtualization must be enabled, and Windows Pro or Enterprise is required. On first launch, Synix starts battlegroup.bat as Administrator. Select initial-setup and have your Self-Host Token ready. Synix can install, update, back up, and launch the deployment, but the game owns the virtual machines and their running state. Official guide: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

launchBehavior.readyMessage: Have your Self-Host Token ready for the battlegroup.bat initial-setup prompt.
